results.summary_before: This is a factory test module that either outputs a counter or mirrors the bidirectional pins to the output pins based on a select input. results.summary_before: This project implements a 4-bit combination lock with a maximum of three unlock attempts and a master reset. Silicon testing confirms that setting the password, unlocking, and the lockout after three wrong attempts all function correctly.
